สื่อสารระดับใช้งานได้ (ฟัง พูด) สำหรับคำศัพท์เชิงเทคนิคและการประสานงานทั่วไป ทักษะและบุคลิกภาพ (Core Skills): มีความละเอียดรอบคอบสูง เป็นระเบียบ และมีความรับผิดชอบ ปรับตัวได้ไว Team Assistant Industry: Travel Technology / IT Startup Location: Chaweng, Koh Samui, Thailand (On-site) Employment Type: Full-time (Monday – Friday, 09:00 – 18:00 | 1-hour lunch break) Compensation: 15,000 – 25,000 THB Net (Commensurate with skills and experience) Probation: 3 months Reporting to: Female Thai CEO About the Role We are a fast-moving TravelTech startup on the vibrant island of Koh Samui looking for an agile, multilingual Team Assistant . In this dynamic role, you will work closely with and report directly to our female Thai CEO. You will act as the vital bridge connecting our Myanmar IT engineering team with our local Thai operations (Accounting, Finance, Sales, and HR). Additionally, you will play a hands-on role in product localization/manual QA testing and ensure executive administrative operations run seamlessly. Localization & Manual Quality Assurance (QA): Test mobile applications and web platforms from a Thai end-user perspective. Document and submit clear, actionable bug reports directly to the engineering team. Burmese/Myanmar: Fluent proficiency (Listening & Speaking) for seamless daily collaboration with the IT team. English: Conversational to working proficiency (Listening & Speaking) for technical terminology and executive communication. review_candidates.title: Systems Integration Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA has manufacturing sites across the globe, including Belgium, China, Germany, Israel, Singapore and Milpitas (CA). The Global Operations (GOPS) team, comprised of Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Installation, and Quality, is responsible for manufacturing our leading-edge technology. We partner with our world-wide supply base and our design engineering teams to bring new products to market. The GOPS team is continuously working to build our products Better, Faster, Cheaper. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) Division provides industry leading metrology solutions for worldwide semiconductor IC manufacturers. The FaST Division portfolio of metrology products includes hardware and software solutions for optical film thickness, optical critical dimension (CD), composition, and resistivity measurement systems. These products are essential for the IC manufacturers as they provide critical metrology capabilities for the development and implementation of their advanced IC processes. The division consists of a global team located in US, Israel, China, and India. The work involves manufacturing machines used as testing and measurement equipment for the semiconductor industry. The scope includes machine manufacturing in a cleanroom environment, encompassing assembly, wiring, alignment, calibration, and final testing. Minimum Qualifications Practical Engineer certification Strong hands-on technical skills in mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, system integration, and final testing Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams Ability to work accurately and consistently in a cleanroom manufacturing environment while following written procedures High level of responsibility, reliability, and attention to detail Strong proficiency in English, including reading, writing, and verbal comprehension procedures, documentation, and professional email communication handling both hardware and software-related issues Experience working in a manufacturing environment – an advantage Previous experience in the semiconductor industry – a strong advantage We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Operations Management is seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead a global team that's evolving from reactive troubleshooting to proactive automation and engineering excellence using Agentic Al. AWS Operations Management (AWSOM) handles operational infrastructure responsibility for all services in AWS commercial regions, enabling service teams to focus on customer engagement and innovation development. The team automates operational tasks to eliminate toil and simplify operations without requiring deep service expertise, providing consistent operational experience across AWS. AWSOM is accountable for critical operational metrics including service pipeline freshness, host maintenance, and security campaign remediation. The team's vision centers on scaling operational excellence through automation and engineering discipline. At BIC World, you are empowered to take ownership of your career and use your unique perspective to make a meaningful, global impact on our mission.
